FA2.title: First American
FA2.description:
Building a data-driven segmentation tool with Databricks and Apache Superset to help five UX research teams filter and visualize candidates across dozens of features for faster interview and design decisions.

Built a scalable, end-to-end data mining pipeline on Databricks with Pyspark to generate features for machine learning use cases and transform First American data from silver to gold.

FA1.title: First American
FA1.description:
Built AWS-integrated UIs using Lambda, API Gateway, S3, & Bedrock, reducing workload per agent by 3 hours.

Spearheaded a machine learning project to predict title order closing dates; extracted and transformed 400k+ orders from Databricks using Spark SQL, developed models with Scikit-Learn, AWS Sagemaker, & Databricks AutoML.

Integrated feature flags with LaunchDarkly on a legacy API with C#, .NET, and Microsoft SQL Server.

dll.title: Digital Learning Lab
dll.description: Collaborated with NSF initiative to develop intelligent writing coach used in pilot study of 100+ engineering students. Applied fine-tuning, retrieval-augmented generation, and automated scoring with OpenAI and Python.

daplab.title: Design and Partnership Lab
daplab.description:
Collaborated with Chan-Zuckerberg initiative to develop AI dashboard evaluating student performance through LLMs; used prompt engineering techniques (e.g. few-shot, chain-of-thought) to assess ~500 responses up to 75% accuracy.

Presented at 8 national conferences (e.g. SCCUR, NCUR) for audiences of 50+ professionals and researchers.

OAI1.title: Office of Outreach, Access, and Inclusion
OAI1.description: Design, update, and facilitate maintenance of OAI sites. Circulate a weekly newsletter for an audience of nearly 100 transfer students in the S-STEM Pathways to Engineering Collaborative.

OAI2.title: Office of Outreach, Access, and Inclusion
OAI2.description: Instructed five summer programs and collaborated with colleagues to develop material on Raspberry Pi, Python, R, & Onshape for 100+ middle to college level students with underrepresented backgrounds. Provided guidance, mentorship, and a sense of community.
